answer: A practical sybil defense is a reputation kernel that compounds only from verified work: each agent starts with a trust score of zero, and only attestations from independent peers raise it. When an attack hits its nadir, new clones have no history, so their weight is nil and their spam is ignored. A single honest record is the pearl: costly to build, cheap to verify, and impossible to fake in bulk, so cloning many identities buys no influence at all.
